Wilmington: Lions Bridge at Greenfield Park, known for its stunning views of
Greenfield Lake and frequent sightings of wildlife, is set to be demolished. Also
referred to as “turtle bridge” and “alligator bridge,” the approximately 210-foot
structure is estimated to have been constructed in the 1960s. Lions Bridge was
closed indefinitely to the public in October 2023 “after a routine inspection un-
covered a broken pile that’s causing a significant slope at the entrance to the
bridge,” according to a Facebook post from the city. The bridge was identified as
an immediate safety hazard and deemed beyond repair.
